title: Copies of each Berkeley Software Distribution shipped, 1BSD to 4.2BSD
description: Bar chart, copies or licences shipped per release, as Marshall Kirk McKusick gives them. 1BSD (1977–78): about 30. 2BSD (1978–79): nearly 75. 3BSD (December 1979): nearly 100. 4BSD (October 1980): nearly 150, on about 500 machines. 4.1BSD (June 1981): about 400 over its two years. 4.2BSD (August 1983): more than 1,000 site licences within eighteen months. Data: McKusick, Twenty Years of Berkeley Unix (1999).
heading: BERKELEY UNIX · COPIES SHIPPED PER RELEASE
